newsitem.title: UK: BAe shares rise as SBC Warburg repeats "buy".
newsitem.headline: BAe shares rise as SBC Warburg repeats "buy".

text.p: Shares in British Aerospace set a record for the third consecutive session on Friday after SBC Warburg reiterated its "buy" recommendation on the company, market sources said.
BAe touched an all-time high of 1,162p before easing back to 1,160p in the early afternoon, up 20p or 1.75 percent on the day. The broad market was up 0.47 percent.

Market sources said SBC Warburg had set a target price of 1,300p on the stock, which has gained heavily recently on optimism BAe will be strongly positioned in a race to lead European defence industry consolidation.
